title: Applying existing metadata on fresh database is not creating event triggers using cli workflow
body: Events are shown in console but the backing triggers in postgres are not being created in database.

comments.author: abdullah2993
comments.body: latest `v2.35.0`. Metadata was generated using version `v2.21.0`

comments.author: abdullah2993
comments.body: haven't checked, let me give it a shot...will get back to you asap

comments.author: tirumaraiselvan
comments.body: Just to be clear, you are not able to see events being generated for event triggers in v2.35?

comments.author: abdullah2993
comments.body: the events are created as in I can see them in the UI but the backing triggers that are created in postgres named `notify_hasura_*` are not created.

comments.author: tirumaraiselvan
comments.body: Can you paste the screenshot pls? Events are generated by the Postgres trigger so it's not clear what you are referring to.

comments.author: abdullah2993
comments.body:
1. have a fresh database, nothing in it.
2. apply metadata using hasura-cli (that has events)
3. apply migrations using hasura-cli
4. reload metadata using hasura-cli
5. open hasura console
6. go to events tab I can see event triggers
7. open pgadmin go to table, no `notify_hasura_` triggers

Hopefully that makes sense
